answer_1.quote: Image captioning technology produces automatic image descriptions ... we propose to automatically compute a quality estimation score QE(image, caption) for a generated caption ...

answer_2.quote: Model selection is done by picking the checkpoint that maximizes the dev set Spearman's correlation ρ_S (y, ŷ). ... We use Mean Squared Error (MSE) as the loss function.

answer_4.quote: We present (image, caption) pairs and ask volunteer raters the following coarse binary question, "Is this a good caption for the image?" ...
answer_4.guideline: Binary good/bad judgment of the caption for the image.
